lines.en: label chinamidate5:
I tap on Chinami’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点开 Chinami 的名字，等她接。

lines.en: Chika should probably be at work already, so if I want to spend time with the mini-version of her, now would probably be best.
lines.zh: Chika 大概已经去上班了，所以如果我想跟她的迷你版待一会儿，现在大概最合适。

lines.en: To be fair, Chika probably wouldn’t mind either way, but the idea of asking a [teenage]girl for her permission to do what I want to do just sounds annoying.
lines.zh: 说句公道话，Chika 大概怎么都无所谓，但要我去问一个[teenage]女孩准不准我做我想做的事，光想想就烦。

lines.en: : Chinami hotline! This is the CEO, Chinami speaking!
lines.zh: : Chinami 热线！这里是首席执行官 Chinami！

lines.en: : How many giraffes would you like to order?
lines.zh: : 您想订购几只长颈鹿？

lines.en: : The Chinami hotline sure sells some strange things.
lines.zh: : Chinami 热线卖的东西还真是奇怪。

lines.en: : Do you have a permit to be selling giraffes, Chinami?
lines.zh: : 你有卖长颈鹿的许可证吗，Chinami？

lines.en: : Are you buying anything or are you just calling to take up my time?
lines.zh: : 您到底买不买，还是说打电话来就为了占我的时间？

lines.en: : I have a very important business to run! These giraffes are not going to sell themselves!
lines.zh: : 我有一桩非常重要的生意要经营！这些长颈鹿可不会自己卖出去！

lines.en: I can see that Chika’s customer service genes must have also been passed down to her sister.
lines.zh: 看来 Chika 的客服基因也传给了她妹妹。

lines.en: : Are you doing anything today, Chinami?
lines.zh: : Chinami，你今天有什么安排吗？

lines.en: : Chinami never does anything. She just sits in a room and cries.
lines.zh: : Chinami 从来什么安排都没有。她就是坐在房间里哭。

lines.en: : Chinami thinks you should come over and play with her!
lines.zh: : Chinami 觉得你应该过来陪她玩！

lines.en: : Sure thing...I’ll head over now.
lines.zh: : 没问题……我现在就过去。

lines.en: : Hooray! And I will put you down for three giraffes in the meantime.
lines.zh: : 好耶！那这期间我给你记上三只长颈鹿。

lines.en: : I don’t want any giraffes, though.
lines.zh: : 可我不想要长颈鹿啊。

lines.en: : Sorry! No refunds!
lines.zh: : 抱歉！概不退换！

lines.en: : Bye-bye!
lines.zh: : 拜拜！

lines.en: Chinami hangs up the phone and I find myself already on the way to her house.
lines.zh: Chinami 挂断电话，而我发现自己已经在去她家的路上了。

lines.en: Hopefully the cost of three giraffes is somewhere in the realm of one pizza so I can just order her dinner in order to settle my debt.
lines.zh: 希望三只长颈鹿的价钱在一份披萨的范畴之内，这样我就能干脆给她点个晚饭，把债还上。

lines.en: scene chinamistorytime1
I sit at the table alongside a girl significantly younger than me as she looks up in admiration or...naivety or...confusion.
lines.zh: 我坐在桌边，身旁是个比我小非常多的女孩，她抬头看着我，眼里是崇拜，或者……天真，或者……困惑。

lines.en: Chinami seems to only have two facial settings.
lines.zh: Chinami 似乎只有两种表情模式。

lines.en: One that is entirely wholesome and-
lines.zh: 一种是完全纯良无害的——

lines.en: scene chinamistorytime2
: Wanna watch Chinami slaughter pigs on her phone?
lines.zh: : 想看 Chinami 在手机上屠猪吗？

lines.en: And one that is pure evil.
lines.zh: 另一种则是纯粹邪恶。

lines.en: : You’re still playing that game?
lines.zh: : 你还在玩那个游戏？

lines.en: scene chinamistorytime1
: Chinami has all the time in the world to play games since she can’t go outside.
lines.zh: : Chinami 有大把大把的时间玩游戏，因为她不能出门。

lines.en: : The pig game is also the only thing she’s better than her sister at, so Chinami needs to keep polishing her skills or she'll be left behind.
lines.zh: : 而且这个猪游戏是她唯一比姐姐强的东西，所以 Chinami 得不断磨炼技术，不然就会被甩在后面。

lines.en: : That’s fair but Chika doesn’t seem like that big of a gamer to begin with.
lines.zh: : 有道理，不过 Chika 本来也不像那么爱打游戏的人。

lines.en: : All big sis does is watch cute girls dance on her phone. Chinami’s phone-time is much better and more fulfilling.
lines.zh: : 姐姐整天就是在手机上看可爱女孩跳舞。Chinami 的手机时间有意义得多，也充实得多。

lines.en: : She has also mastered geometry.
lines.zh: : 她还精通几何。

lines.en: : I’m very proud of you, Chinami.
lines.zh: : 我为你感到非常骄傲，Chinami。

lines.en: : So, if you don’t want to play games with Chinami, what would you like to do?
lines.zh: : 那么，要是你不想跟 Chinami 玩游戏，你想做什么？

lines.en: : Dance? Sing?
lines.zh: : 跳舞？唱歌？

lines.en: : I can’t say I’m much of a...well, either of those things.
lines.zh: : 我得说，这两样我都不太……嗯，都不在行。

lines.en: : Maybe you can teach Chinami things since you are a teacher?
lines.zh: : 也许你可以教 Chinami 点什么，毕竟你是个老师？

lines.en: : She wants to know what kinds of lessons the big girls learn so she can be prepared when she’s allowed to go to[school].
lines.zh: : 她想知道大女孩们都学些什么，这样等她获准去[school]的时候就能有所准备。

lines.en: {i}If{/i} she’s ever allowed to go to[school].
lines.zh: {i}如果{/i}她真能获准去[school]的话。

lines.en: I don’t know much about Chinami’s situation, but the way Chika put it mixed with the fact that she can’t even go out in public without gloves and a mask is...rather telling.
lines.zh: 我不太了解 Chinami 的情况，但 Chika 的说法，加上她连出门都得戴手套和口罩这个事实，已经很能说明问题。

lines.en: But who knows? Maybe she’ll be able to do things the rest of us can do someday?
lines.zh: 不过谁知道呢？也许有一天她也能做我们其他人能做到的事？

lines.en: One can only wait and see.
lines.zh: 只能等着瞧了。

lines.en: : Today is my day off. And you can’t afford to buy lessons from me either way.
lines.zh: : 今天我休息。而且不管怎么说，你也买不起我的课。

lines.en: : What if Chinami gives you a discount on your four giraffes?
lines.zh: : 那要是 Chinami 给你的四只长颈鹿打个折呢？

lines.en: : Wasn’t it only three?
lines.zh: : 不是只有三只吗？

lines.en: : Wait, I didn’t even want any in the first place.
lines.zh: : 等等，我一开始根本就不想要啊。

lines.en: : I added another one as a penalty for you being late.
lines.zh: : 我因为你迟到，又加了一只当罚金。

lines.en: : That’s what the adults call “interest.”
lines.zh: : 大人们管这叫「利息」。

lines.en: : That is a very strange take on the concept of interest but you’re not entirely wrong.
lines.zh: : 你对「利息」这个概念的理解很奇怪，但你也不算全错。

lines.en: : Can you at least read Chinami a story?
lines.zh: : 那至少你能给 Chinami 读个故事吗？

lines.en: : Big sis Yumi keeps a stack of manga in her side of the closet and Chinami likes to read them when no one else is home.
lines.zh: : Yumi 姐姐在柜子她那一侧堆了一摞漫画，没人在家的时候 Chinami 喜欢看。

lines.en: scene chinamistorytime2
: She likes the ones with lots of blood the most.
lines.zh: : 她最喜欢血多的那种。

lines.en: : Of course she does.
lines.zh: : 她当然喜欢了。

lines.en: : Fine. Go get something out of the closet, Chinami.
lines.zh: : 好吧。去柜子里拿点东西出来吧，Chinami。

lines.en: scene chinamistorytime3
: Yay! Friendship!
lines.zh: : 好耶！友谊！

lines.en: : Chinami will be right back!
lines.zh: : Chinami 马上就回来！

lines.en: scene chinamistorytime4
Chinami scurries over to the other side of the room and quickly opens the closet door, stopping it with her foot just before it bumps against the wall.
lines.zh: Chinami 快步跑到房间另一头，迅速拉开柜门，在门撞到墙之前用脚抵住。

lines.en: I imagine it’s something she’s been scolded about in the past judging by the chipped paint and dents near where the door handle would typically land.
lines.zh: 从门把手通常会撞上的位置那剥落的油漆和凹痕来看，我想她以前一定因为这事挨过骂。

lines.en: Also, is now a good time to say that I think Chinami and Kaori would get along strangely well?
lines.zh: 还有，现在说这个合适吗——我觉得 Chinami 和 Kaori 会莫名地合得来。

lines.en: The two of them seem to only want companionship and...I don’t know if Kaori even has the mental capacity to comprehend any strangeness regarding hanging out with a girl Chinami’s age.
lines.zh: 她们俩似乎只想要陪伴，而且……我不知道 Kaori 的心智能力是否足以理解，跟 Chinami 这个年纪的女孩混在一起有什么奇怪的。

lines.en: But, then again, it might be difficult convincing Chika to let someone who looks like Kaori inside in the first place.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，光是说服 Chika 让长得像 Kaori 那样的人进门，恐怕就够难的。

lines.en: scene chinamistorytime5
: Chinami has returned with a book that has no blood in it. She doesn’t want you to get scared and run away.
lines.zh: : Chinami 拿回来一本没有血的书。她不想把你吓跑。

lines.en: : I’m a mature adult and would not run away from something as trivial as that.
lines.zh: : 我是个成熟的成年人，不会因为那种小事就跑掉。

lines.en: : Chinami doesn’t know what {i}trivial{/i} means but she believes you.
lines.zh: : Chinami 不知道{i}小事{/i}是什么意思，但她相信你。

lines.en: : She also has a rule when it comes to story time.
lines.zh: : 故事时间她还有一条规矩。

lines.en: : A rule? What kind of rule?
lines.zh: : 规矩？什么规矩？

lines.en: : Since Chinami has read this manga so many times already, she knows the story by heart.
lines.zh: : 因为这本漫画 Chinami 已经看过好多遍了，她把剧情背得滚瓜烂熟。

lines.en: : So she wants you to make up your own story and tell it to her.
lines.zh: : 所以她想让你自己编一个故事讲给她听。

lines.en: : Why do I suddenly need to be creative? All I was planning on doing was reading.
lines.zh: : 我怎么突然就得有创造力了？我本来只打算读一读的。

lines.en: : Because if you don’t, Chinami will tell her big sis that you did all kinds of mean stuff to her while she was at work.
lines.zh: : 因为你要是不编，Chinami 就跟她姐姐说，趁她上班的时候你对她做了很多很多过分的事。

lines.en: : Are you...blackmailing me?
lines.zh: : 你这是在……勒索我？

lines.en: : Chinami is Chinami-mailing you.
lines.zh: : Chinami 是在 Chinami 诈你。

lines.en: : She just wants to have fun with her friend.
lines.zh: : 她只是想跟朋友一起开心。

lines.en: scene chinamistorytime6
: And will eliminate you if you don’t listen to her.
lines.zh: : 而你要是不听话，她就会把你消灭掉。

lines.en: : Take Chinami’s book.
lines.zh: : 拿着 Chinami 的书。

lines.en: I’m starting to think that “Game of Thrones” thing might have been a bad influence on this adorable little flower.
lines.zh: 我开始觉得，那部《权力的游戏》可能对这朵可爱的小花产生了不好的影响。

lines.en: She’s gone from being a daisy to some sort of...venus fly trap or something.
lines.zh: 她从一朵雏菊变成了某种……捕蝇草之类的东西。

lines.en: scene chinamistorytime7
I take the book out of Chinami’s hands and open up to a random page since it doesn’t really matter what I read in the first place.
lines.zh: 我从 Chinami 手里接过书，随手翻到一页，反正我读什么本来也无所谓。

lines.en: She moves closer to the table and slides her legs underneath it, bumping into one of my knees as she does so.
lines.zh: 她往桌子这边挪了挪，把腿伸到桌下，中途撞到了我的一只膝盖。

lines.en: It’s a small table, so it’s not exactly an easy fit for both of our limbs, but we make do with the space we have and I...
lines.zh: 桌子很小，要同时容下我们俩的腿确实不容易，但我们还是将就着利用起这点空间，而我……

lines.en: Well, I guess I allow myself to be blackmailed?
lines.zh: 嗯，大概是我允许自己被勒索了吧？

lines.en: Or, excuse me, Chinami-mailed.
lines.zh: 或者说，抱歉，被 Chinami 诈了。

lines.en: scene chinamistorytime8
: So...uhh...
: A long, long time ago in a galaxy far, far away.
lines.zh: : 很久很久以前，在一个非常遥远的星系里。

lines.en: : Chinami has seen that movie before. Try something else.
lines.zh: : 这部电影 Chinami 看过了。换个别的。

lines.en: : How about you just tell me what kind of story you want to hear.
lines.zh: : 不如你直接告诉我想听什么样的故事。

lines.en: : Hmm...
: Chinami wants to hear a story about a little girl who grows up to be the CEO of Chinami-Corp! The biggest Japanese dealer of cute animals!
lines.zh: : Chinami 想听这么一个故事：一个小女孩长大后成了 Chinami-Corp 的首席执行官！日本最大的可爱动物经销商！

lines.en: : It doesn’t have to be a story about Chinami as long as the company is named Chinami-Corp.
lines.zh: : 故事不一定要讲 Chinami，只要公司叫 Chinami-Corp 就行。

lines.en: : But why would-
lines.zh: : 可为什么要——

lines.en: : Actually, nevermind. Fine.
lines.zh: : 算了，当我没问。好吧。

lines.en: : A decently long time ago in a land pretty close to here-
lines.zh: : 在离这儿挺近的一片土地上，相当久以前——

lines.en: : There was a little girl named...Chiaki.
lines.zh: : 有个小女孩叫……Chiaki。

lines.en: : Chiaki was Chinami’s mom’s name!
lines.zh: : Chiaki 是 Chinami 妈妈的名字！

lines.en: scene chinamistorytime9
: Oh. Uhh...Should I change it?
lines.zh: : 哦。呃……我要不要换个名字？

lines.en: : No. Chinami thinks it’s a good name. Other girls are allowed to have it.
lines.zh: : 不用。Chinami 觉得这是个好名字。别的女孩也可以用。

lines.en: : Please continue!
lines.zh: : 请继续！

lines.en: scene chinamistorytime8
: Okay, so...Chiaki was a pretty normal girl for most of her life.
lines.zh: : 好的，那么……Chiaki 大半辈子都是个挺普通的女孩。

lines.en: : In her free time she did things like...painting or...jump-rope...or Skee-Ball.
lines.zh: : 空闲的时候，她会做些比如……画画、跳绳，或者 Skee-Ball。

lines.en: : What’s Skee-Ball?
lines.zh: : Skee-Ball 是什么？

lines.en: : A relic of the past.
lines.zh: : 一件过去的遗物。

lines.en: : It sounds fun.
lines.zh: : 听起来很好玩。

lines.en: : I haven’t even told you what it is.
lines.zh: : 我还没告诉你那是什么呢。

lines.en: : Chinami guesses you wear skis and kick a ball around.
lines.zh: : Chinami 猜是穿上滑雪板，然后四处踢球。

lines.en: : Wrong. This is exactly why you need to listen instead of speaking out.
lines.zh: : 错。所以说你该听着，而不是插嘴。

lines.en: : Chinami is sorry. She will behave.
lines.zh: : Chinami 抱歉。她会乖乖的。

lines.en: : Good. So, anyway...
lines.zh: : 很好。那么，言归正传……

lines.en: : One day, Chiaki was on a field trip to a museum or something and she was suddenly bit by a radioactive spider.
lines.zh: : 有一天，Chiaki 去博物馆什么的参加校外活动，突然被一只放射性蜘蛛咬了。

lines.en: scene chinamistorytime10
: Wow! A plot twist this early!
lines.zh: : 哇！这么早就来剧情转折！

lines.en: : Chinami is shocked!
lines.zh: : Chinami 震惊了！

lines.en: : What color was the spider?
lines.zh: : 那只蜘蛛是什么颜色的？

lines.en: : Brown.
lines.zh: : 棕色。

lines.en: scene chinamistorytime11
: That just sounds like a normal spider.
lines.zh: : 那听起来就是只普通的蜘蛛啊。

lines.en: : It was only slightly radioactive.
lines.zh: : 它只是有轻微的放射性。

lines.en: scene chinamistorytime8
: Anyway, Chiaki went home and continued to live her normal life for the next three weeks.
lines.zh: : 总之，Chiaki 回了家，在接下来的三个星期里继续过着她的普通生活。

lines.en: : She was almost positive the radioactive spider was going to have some sort of life-changing effect on her, but sooner or later she realized that all she gained was...extreme customer service skills.
lines.zh: : 她几乎肯定那只放射性蜘蛛会给她带来某种改变人生的效果，可迟早她会意识到，自己得到的只是……极强的客服技能。

lines.en: scene chinamistorytime11
: Chinami found a plothole.
lines.zh: : Chinami 发现了一个剧情漏洞。

lines.en: : How did Chiaki know the spider was radioactive if it just looked like a normal spider and didn’t give her powers?
lines.zh: : 要是那只蜘蛛看起来就是普通的蜘蛛，也没给她任何超能力，Chiaki 怎么会知道它是放射性的？

lines.en: : Be quiet. This is my story.
lines.zh: : 安静。这是我的故事。

lines.en: I feel strangely irritated by my story being interrupted all of a sudden despite not caring at all just a few minutes prior.
lines.zh: 明明几分钟前我还毫不在乎，现在故事被打断却莫名地让我烦躁起来。

lines.en: How dare this tiny human find plot-holes in my work.
lines.zh: 这个小小的人类竟敢在我的作品里挑剧情漏洞。

lines.en: : Chinami is sorry. Please don’t kidnap her.
lines.zh: : Chinami 抱歉。请别绑架她。

lines.en: : Please don’t insinuate that that’s a thing I would do if I were angry.
lines.zh: : 别暗示我生气了就会干出那种事。

lines.en: : Big sis Yumi has warned Chinami that you’ve kidnapped girls in the past.
lines.zh: : Yumi 姐姐警告过 Chinami，说你以前绑架过女孩。

lines.en: : I don’t think you should listen to Yumi anymore. I’ve never kidnapped anyone.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你不该再听 Yumi 的话了。我从没绑架过任何人。

lines.en: : But, back to the story...
lines.zh: : 不过，回到故事……

lines.en: scene chinamistorytime8
: After Chiaki gained her radioactive customer service powers, the only thing she wanted to do with her life was sell things to people.
lines.zh: : 在 Chiaki 获得了放射性客服超能力之后，她这辈子唯一想做的事，就是卖东西给别人。

lines.en: : The problem was that Chiaki also lived on a farm, so all she could sell were animals.
lines.zh: : 问题在于，Chiaki 还住在一个农场里，所以她能卖的只有动物。

lines.en: : What about vegetables? They have vegetables on farms.
lines.zh: : 那蔬菜呢？农场上是有蔬菜的。

lines.en: : The other problem was that this farm only had animals.
lines.zh: : 另一个问题是，这个农场只有动物。

lines.en: : Chinami thinks a farm with only animals just sounds like a lonely zoo.
lines.zh: : Chinami 觉得，只有动物的农场听起来就是个寂寞的动物园。

lines.en: : Chinami should shut up and listen to the end of the story.
lines.zh: : Chinami 该闭嘴，把故事听完。

lines.en: : Chinami thinks you’re just jealous because she’s a better story-teller than you.
lines.zh: : Chinami 觉得你只是嫉妒，因为她的故事讲得比你好。

lines.en: scene chinamistorytime12
: Chinami loves your story. Please continue.
lines.zh: : Chinami 喜欢你的故事。请继续。

lines.en: : It doesn’t sound like it.
lines.zh: : 听起来不像。

lines.en: : She’s just excited to be spending time with her future dad. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 她只是很高兴能跟她未来的爸爸待在一起。就这样。

lines.en: scene chinamistorytime13
: Hah...
How in the world am I supposed to stay mad when she goes and says things like that?
lines.zh: 她都说出那种话了，我到底要怎么继续生气下去？

lines.en: Is this what having a kid is like?
lines.zh: 有孩子就是这样的吗？

lines.en: I thought I had a grip on that with Ami, but she jumped straight into her[teen]years rather than whatever’s going on here.
lines.zh: 我以为我在 Ami 身上已经摸清了这一点，可她直接跳进了自己的[teen]时期，而不是眼下这种状况。

lines.en: Granted, Ami didn’t really {i}jump{/i} into her[teen]years. She’s been there since I met her.
lines.zh: 话说回来，Ami 也不算是{i}跳{/i}进她的[teen]时期的。我认识她的时候她就已经在那儿了。

lines.en: But still.
lines.zh: 但总之。

lines.en: I should just try and wrap this story up so the two of us can move onto something more-
lines.zh: 我该赶紧把这个故事收个尾，好让我们俩能去做点更——

lines.en: scene chinamistorytime14
: Chinami! I’m back!
lines.zh: : Chinami！我回来了！

lines.en: : Uh-oh.
lines.zh: : 呃哦。

lines.en: : Big sis Yumi is home!
lines.zh: : Yumi 姐姐到家了！

lines.en: : Story time will have to wait!
lines.zh: : 故事时间得往后推了！

lines.en: : Heh? Story time? You never have story time by yourself. Is Chika back from work al-
lines.zh: : 哈？故事时间？你自己一个人的时候可从来不会有什么故事时间。Chika 下班回来了吗——

lines.en: scene chinamistorytime15
: Welcome home!
lines.zh: : 欢迎回家！

lines.en: : ...Welcome home!
lines.zh: : ……欢迎回家！

lines.en: scene chinamistorytime16
: D-DON’T GIVE ME THAT {i}WELCOME HOME{/i} BULLSHIT!
lines.zh: : 别、别跟我来那套{i}欢迎回家{/i}的鬼话！

lines.en: : WHAT THE FUCK DO YOU THINK YOU’RE DOING IN HERE?!
lines.zh: : 你他妈到底以为自己在这儿干什么？！

lines.en: : I SWEAR TO GOD IF YOU SO MUCH AS LAY A FINGER ON HER I WILL MURDER YOU!
lines.zh: : 我向天发誓，你要是敢碰她一根指头，我就杀了你！

lines.en: : Uh-oh! Big sis Yumi only uses bad words when she’s {i}really{/i} angry.
lines.zh: : 呃哦！Yumi 姐姐只有在{i}真的{/i}很生气的时候才会说脏话。

lines.en: : Don’t worry, big sis Yumi! Sensei said he won’t kidnap me!
lines.zh: : 别担心，Yumi 姐姐！Sensei 说了他不会绑架我的！

lines.en: scene chinamistorytime17
: HOW DID THAT EVEN COME UP IN CONVERSATION?!
lines.zh: : 这他妈是怎么聊到这儿来的？！

lines.en: : A better question is why you told her I’d kidnap her in the first-
lines.zh: : 更好的问题是，你凭什么一开始就跟她说我会绑架——

lines.en: scene chinamistorytime16
: NO ONE ASKED YOU! GET THE FUCK OUT OF HERE!
lines.zh: : 没人问你！给我他妈滚出去！

lines.en: : DOES...DOES CHIKA EVEN KNOW YOU’RE HERE?!
lines.zh: : CHIKA 到底知不知道你在这儿？！

lines.en: : Well...not exact-
lines.zh: : 嗯……不完全——

lines.en: : Yup! Chinami told her!
lines.zh: : 知道！Chinami 跟她说了！

lines.en: Well.
lines.zh: 好吧。

lines.en: That’s...awkward.
lines.zh: 那……挺尴尬的。

lines.en: scene chinamistorytime18
: And she was okay with it?...
lines.zh: : 而她就同意了？……

lines.en: : Ew ew ew ew ew ew ew ew ew...
lines.zh: : 呕呕呕呕呕呕呕呕呕……

lines.en: scene chinamistorytime16
: AHHH THAT’S SO FUCKING GROSS!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊太他妈恶心了！

lines.en: scene chinamistorytime19
: And wait a fucking minute! What are you holding?! What are you reading to her?!
lines.zh: : 还有，等他妈一下！你手里拿的是什么？！你在给她读什么？！

lines.en: : Oh, Chinami told me about your manga collection so-
lines.zh: : 哦，Chinami 跟我说了你的漫画收藏，所以——

lines.en: scene chinamistorytime20
: GET! THE FUCK! OUT OF HERE!
lines.zh: : 给！我！滚！出！去！

lines.en: : AND NEVER COME BACK!
lines.zh: : 还有！永远别再回来！

lines.en: : And that’s my cue to leave.
lines.zh: : 那我就该走了。

lines.en: scene black
: But we didn’t finish story time yet!
lines.zh: : 可我们故事时间还没结束呢！

lines.en: : Chinami needs to know what happens to Chinami-Corp!
lines.zh: : Chinami 得知道 Chinami-Corp 后来怎么样了！

lines.en: : I’ll tell you some other-
lines.zh: : 我改天再告诉——

lines.en: : YOU ABSOLUTELY WILL NOT!
lines.zh: : 你绝对不许！

lines.en: : OUT! NOW!
lines.zh: : 出去！现在！

lines.en: : Or not.
lines.zh: : 或者不走也行。

lines.en: : Later, Chinami. Later, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 回头见，Chinami。回头见，Yumi。

lines.en: : DIE IN A FIRE!
lines.zh: : 去死吧，烧死你！

lines.en: Well, that could have gone better.
lines.zh: 好吧，那事本可以收场得更好。

lines.en: I wish Chinami would have said something about Yumi being able to show up at any minute, but-
lines.zh: 我倒希望 Chinami 能提前跟我说一声 Yumi 随时可能出现，不过——

lines.en: To be fair, I probably should have expected something like that sooner or later.
lines.zh: 说句公道话，我大概早该料到迟早会有这种事。

lines.en: That’s Yumi’s home, too, after all.
lines.zh: 毕竟那也是 Yumi 的家。

lines.en: I guess I’ll just...need to be more careful in the future.
lines.zh: 我想我以后……只需要更小心一点。

lines.en: Or at least find a good hiding place.
lines.zh: 或者至少找个好藏身的地方。

lines.en: $ chinamidate5 = True
$ chinami_love += 1
{i}Chinami’s affection has increased to [chinami_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Chinami 的好感度提升到了 [chinami_love]!{/i}

lines.en: jump saturdaynight
